title: Pan-Seared Trout with Rainbow Stew
description: A flavorful and nutritious dish featuring pan-seared trout served with a delicious rainbow stew. The stew is made with a variety of vegetables and tender meat.

ingredients.name: rainbow
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers and carrots

instructions: 2. Season the trout fillets with salt and pepper
3. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and add a small amount of oil
4. Sear the trout fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side
5. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes
6. While the trout is baking, heat a separate skillet over medium heat
7. Add the stew and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally
8. Add the nutty and tender ingredients to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes
9. Stir in the onion and garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes
10. Serve the pan-seared trout with the rainbow stew
